feature_definitions.n_det_conf025: Number of original-image detections with score >= 0.25.
feature_definitions.median_box_area_640: Median detection box area after letterbox scale to 640; same definition as Stage 6.3C.
feature_definitions.tiny_ratio: Fraction of detections whose 640-scale area is < 32^2; same definition as Stage 6.3C.
feature_definitions.tiny_count: Absolute count of detections whose 640-scale area is < 32^2.
feature_definitions.det_density_per_mp: Number of score>=0.25 detections divided by original image megapixels.
feature_definitions.mean_confidence_025: Mean confidence of detections with score >= 0.25.
feature_definitions.box_area_cv_640: Population standard deviation / mean of 640-scale detection box areas.
feature_definitions.grid_occupancy_4x4: Number of occupied cells among a 4x4 grid using normalized original-image box centers, divided by 16.

calculation.coordinate_convention: COCO xywh in original-image pixel coordinates

empty_detection_handling.median_box_area_640: empty CSV cell; converted to NaN by the model pipeline
